set.body:
Source: review finding in AgentStdioServer.scala:80-84.

Problem:
an effect failure in request handling escapes evalMap, emits no correlated response, and terminates processing. In the current one-RPC-per-SSH design this loses the current call; coalesced or future session reuse would amplify the blast radius.

Acceptance:
- Convert every decoded request failure, including timeout and executor failure, into one bounded correlated protocol response.
- Keep framing/decoder corruption distinct from handler-level failure.
- Ensure subsequent coalesced frames can still be processed when the framing stream remains valid.
- Add tests for timed-out sbatch, handler exceptions, redaction, and a valid request following a failed request.
set.title: P6f.3: Contain agent handler failures per request
